item.description:
Koegaki 1.6.0

  • Each dictation now stays on your clipboard after it is inserted, so if a paste missed you can paste it again. A dictation that came in parts is on the clipboard whole.
  • New in Settings: Restore my previous clipboard after inserting. Turn it on and Koegaki puts back what you had copied before, once the paste lands. Off is the default.
  • If part of a dictation could not be confirmed, the notice names that part and says the whole dictation is on your clipboard, instead of asking you to paste again.
